title: The Road Without a Loop
reflection:
For years the road curved back on itself — a wheel, a season repeating. Today it runs straight ahead, and there's no pretending otherwise.

This isn't the absence of the walk. It's a new stretch of the same road, with its own kind of grace, unhurried by any count of days.
closing: God of the open road, walk this straight stretch with me. I don't need a wheel to turn to know you are near. Amen.

scripture.text: I am about to do a new thing; now it springs forth, do you not perceive it?

title: What the Body Carried
reflection:
Every cycle you ever walked, every phase you learned to recognise by feel — none of it was wasted. It shaped the woman walking this new country.

Today, let yourself remember without grief crowding out gratitude. Your body has been faithful company for a long time; it still is.
closing: God who remembers every step, thank you for the years behind me. Let their wisdom walk with me still. Amen.

scripture.text: Hitherto the Lord has helped us.

title: A Quieter Weather
reflection:
No monthly storm to brace for now — just an ordinary day, its weather steadier than it's been in a long while.

There can be a grief in that quiet, and a relief in it too, sometimes both at once. Let today hold whichever one shows up, without needing to choose.
closing: God of steady weather, thank you for this calm. Where there's grief inside it, receive that too — you have room for both. Amen.

scripture.text: Be still, and know that I am God.

title: Wide Enough for This
reflection:
Nothing to track, no phase to name, no wheel demanding you notice where you stand on it. Just the walk itself, wide open in front of you.

That width can feel disorienting at first — freedom often does. Let it become spaciousness instead: room to walk exactly as today asks, unscheduled by anything but grace.
closing: God of open country, thank you for this widened road. Teach me to walk it freely, without missing the wheel I've set down. Amen.

scripture.text: You will show me the path of life; in your presence there is fullness of joy.

title: Still the Same Companion
reflection:
Journeys change. Bodies change. What has walked beside you through every one of them has not.

However unfamiliar this stretch of road feels, you are not walking it for the first time alone. The same presence that met you in the cycle meets you in the wide country too.
closing: God who never changes companions, thank you for staying through every season of this road. Walk on with me now. Amen.

scripture.text: I am with you always, to the end of the age.
